name: router-llm
description: Enable the LLM-based task router for agent dispatch decisions.

name: embeddings
description: Enable vector embeddings generation for documents and memories.

name: memory-llm-extract
description: Extract structured memories from conversations using LLM.

name: saas-auth
description: Enable SaaS authentication providers (OAuth, magic-link, email OTP). Email auth (magic-link / OTP) requires notify-email to also be ON for end-to-end delivery.

name: real-time-collab-server
description: Enable real-time collaborative editing via WebSocket server.

name: external-llm-provider
description: Allow connecting to external LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).

name: public-api
description: Expose the public REST API for third-party integrations.

name: outbound-webhooks
description: Enable outbound webhook delivery to external URLs.

name: notify-email
description: Enable email notifications via configured SMTP provider.

name: notify-webhook
description: Enable webhook-based notifications to subscriber endpoints.

name: notify-slack
description: Enable Slack notifications via Slack app integration.

name: notify-discord
description: Enable Discord notifications via Discord webhook integration.

name: casbin-policies
description: Enable ABAC policy enforcement via node-casbin (gated by CasbinRule table).

name: pgvector
description: Enable pgvector extension for native Postgres vector similarity search.

name: connector-linear
description: Enable Linear issue tracker sync via Linear API connector.

name: symphony-ssh-worker
description: Enable Symphony SSH worker for remote command execution.

name: symphony-http-api
description: Enable Symphony HTTP API for webhook-triggered agent runs.

name: i18n
description: Enable locale catalogs, locale picker, and RTL rendering.

name: report-llm-narration
description: Enable LLM-powered memory digest and doc narration via inference sidecar.

name: search-click-telemetry
description: Enable search click telemetry writes to search_clicks table.

name: token-tracking
description: Enable per-profile token count parsing from agent stdout; writes token_used to agent_runs.

name: session-resume
description: Enable session resumption on retry runs (claude-code profile only); passes prior transcript to sandcastle.

name: telemetry-remote
description: Enable remote telemetry batch POST to FULCRUM_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT (HMAC-signed, outbox-queued, graphile-worker flushed).

name: error-reporting-remote
description: Enable remote crash reporting: new ErrorLog entries are POSTed (scrubbed + HMAC-signed) to FULCRUM_ERROR_REPORT_ENDPOINT.

name: desktop-app
description: Enable Tauri desktop integration surfaces and desktop IPC checks.

name: experiments
description: Enable experimental product surfaces gated from default local-first flows.

name: scheduled-backups
description: Enable scheduled local and remote backup tasks.

name: skill-marketplace
description: Enable skill marketplace client and publisher commands.

name: trpc-permission-local-dev-bypass
description: Allow local development tRPC permission bypass logging when Casbin denies access.
